Senses.Explanation: The upward phrase is requested after prior categories or answers have been exhausted. Masters answer it, expose the request, or physically refuse the demand in public interviews. A single phrase becomes the demand for what stands beyond the distinctions just supplied, and the response may be an answer, rebuke, or covered ears. Upward does not designate a spatial direction here; the full questions place it after already answered categories. Different answers and refusals respond to one upward-phrase demand rather than separate lexical objects.
